releaseNotes:
- Fix cramped What's new layout: open release notes in a large modal dialog inside the extension popup rather than expanding the header.
- Give notes the full dialog width and a tall scrollable reading area, with fixed title and Close controls. Support X, Escape, keyboard focus return and plain-text-only content.
- Keep the header notice compact and ignore F9/F10 ticket-operation shortcuts while release notes are open. Update checking, dismissal, browser downloads and ticket operations otherwise remain unchanged.
